subject: QBR + Roadmap: compact demo block — swap / preferred window?
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@clearwave.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: QBR + Roadmap: compact demo block — swap / preferred window?

Hi Ethan —

As we approach your renewal, thought it would be efficient to combine the renewal QBR with a concise roadmap demo into a single 60-minute "compact block" so your execs get both the commercial updates and the product walkthrough in one sitting. We want to make this time high-impact and avoid multiple follow-ups.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 11/11 10:00–11:00
- Thu 11/13 09:00–10:00
- Thu 11/13 14:00–15:00 (preferred for EMEA folks)

Agenda (attached: QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf):
- 5m intro / success recap
- 20m roadmap demo (key features & timing)
- 20m renewal commercial summary / options
- 10m Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan

If none of these work, we can split into two 30m sessions (exec briefing + technical deep dive) — but I wanted to check whether the compact block is feasible on your side. Please flag the best window and any absolute no-go times.

Also calling out logistics: will your CTO be on the call? If not, please advise who should be there for the technical portion.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai
(Attachment: QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf)

From: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@clearwave.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-09T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap: compact demo block — swap / preferred window?

Alex —

Appreciate the proposal. Compact block sounds good in principle — keeps things tight. Quick notes from my side:
- Our VP Product (Lydia) is out Wed–Thu this week, so she can't do 11/13 morning.
- 11/11 at 10:00 PT works for me but our CFO wants a later slot (after 1pm PT).
- If we must pick one, 11/13 14:00 PT would be ideal since it works for our EU stakeholders, but that conflicts with a standing ops review we can't move.

Two options from us:
1) Move forward with Tue 11/11 10:00 PT — I can represent the execs and record for others.
2) Keep 60m but split the commercial portion to an asynchronous pre-read for the CFO and let him join only if he wants the live 20m renewal discussion.

Pre-reads are good — can you share the commercial summary as a one-pager? Also, please send the recording after.

— Ethan
Ethan Jacobs
Director of Product, ClearWave Health
ejacobs@clearwave.io

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@clearwave.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-10T08:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap: compact demo block — swap / preferred window?

Thanks Ethan — that helps.

We can do either:
- Option A: 11/11 10:00 PT, one 60m compact block. We'll record and circulate a 1-page commercial summary beforehand for your CFO.
- Option B: 11/13 14:00 PT as a 45–60m session but we offer an "exec slice" (first 15–20 minutes recorded + 1-pager) for anyone who can only join asynchronously.

Operational suggestion: Let's lock 11/11 10:00 PT now as a soft hold and I will send the calendar invite with "recording + exec summary will be shared". Monica — can you confirm engineering availability for 11/11 10:00 PT (backup: 11/13 14:00 PT) and whether we should include a short tech appendix in the pre-reads?

Proposed mutual action plan if we lock 11/11: 
- Alex: send calendar invite + 1-page commercial summary + link to recording placeholder (by 11/10 EOD PT)
- Monica: confirm engineering attendee(s) + upload tech appendix to the drive (by 11/10 end of day PT)
- Ethan: confirm which execs will join live vs. watch recording (by 11/10)

If that timeline sounds tight, I'm happy to slide the compact block to 11/13 and build more pre-read.

Thanks — Alex
(Attachment: QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@clearwave.io>
Date: 2025-11-11T07:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap: compact demo block — swap / preferred window?

Locking operational constraints:

We can staff 11/11 10:00 PT. Proposed attendees from our side:
- Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer) — high-level QA & live demo shepherd
- Javier Cruz (Backend Lead) — will join for the technical appendix if needed (30m max)
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — commercial & renewal context

Notes / ops checklist (attached runbook stub):
- We'll record the session and upload to the linked Drive folder after the call.
- Tech appendix will be a short 6-slide deck describing migration windows, expected latencies, and KV cache behavior under the workloads you described.
- If CFO-only review: we can mark the first 15m as "exec summary" and pull out the commercial one-pager for asynchronous review.

I uploaded a minimal Ops_Runbook_stub.md to the shared folder and added a calendar description with the recording flag. Please review.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Ops_Runbook_stub.md)

From: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@clearwave.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-13T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap: compact demo block — swap / preferred window?

Alex / Monica —

Confirmed: we'll take the 11/11 10:00 PT compact block. Lydia will watch the recording (out Thursday) and our CFO asked for the one-pager ahead of the call — if you can get that in the invite it would be ideal.

Also, quick ask: can you add a Docusign placeholder for the renewal SOW in the calendar notes (we aim to finalize terms in the week after the QBR)? If you want, I can loop in procurement after the call.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

— Ethan
Ethan Jacobs
Director of Product, ClearWave Health
(Planning: they'll review recording; procurement TBD)
